scripts.deploy:development: npm run minikube:start && echo $(ksync init) && npm run minikube:dns && (minikube dashboard >/dev/null &) && npm run minikube:deploy && sudo echo && (minikube tunnel >/dev/null &)
scripts.deploy:development:hard: eval $(minikube docker-env) && minikube delete --all && docker rmi api || true && minikube image rm api:latest || true && npm run deploy:development && npm run init:lightning
scripts.watch:api: (ksync watch &) && sleep 5 && ksync delete --all && ksync create --selector=app=development-api $(pwd)/api/src /usr/src/app/api/src && kubectl logs --follow --selector=app=development-api
scripts.minikube:dns: minikube addons enable ingress && minikube addons enable ingress-dns && npx ts-node ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube-dns.ts
scripts.minikube:deploy: npm run minikube:loadApi && minikube kubectl -- apply -f ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube.yaml --validate=false
scripts.minikube:loadApi: eval $(minikube docker-env) && (docker image inspect api:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo no || docker build --target development -t api:latest -f api/Dockerfile .) && minikube image load --overwrite=false api:latest
